prior_threads.reason: The map's locations are now mostly identified, the map is traced to Bral and the dwarves' hoard, and Grimny places the treasure in the Dragon's Lair (beat_77). The treasure itself is not yet found.

The lair is located, a faun-wine plan is formed and Lady Hilda and Malzazarik have joined (beat_64). Grimny's account of a small, empty cave and Dunk's suspicion that there is no dragon (beat_77, beat_78) change the shape of the hunt.

Wayman renegotiated the deal: the goblins wall off the stairs, keep the church, antechamber and statue room, and will destroy the church (beat_15, beat_16). Wayman also promised Snurk never to tell King Hogboon where they are (beat_17).
Sir Alfred was left incapacitated but not destroyed (beat_11), so the danger and the question of why he roams remain open.
The question is partly answered: Cedric and Warwick say supplies stopped when the dragon troubles began.
Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows of her visits and is not interested, which leaves her aim crushed (beat_62). Dunk's promise was never released, so the thread stays open.
Not touched this Session; the penance and the donation are still owed.
The party took its first treasure and then consigned it to Cedric under the note. Squints' second pick is still owed and has not been released.

new_threads.name: The holy robes for Brother Dirk's church
new_threads.reason: Dr. Uriah promised to return the robes to the church after the dragon is defeated, and the promise is still owed. The robes proved to be a non-magical relic.

new_threads.name: Cedric's promissory note for the treasure
new_threads.reason: Cedric owes the party three-quarters price, about 975 gold, once the caravans flow again. The note was put toward recruiting the hirelings.

new_threads.name: The Warwick deal
new_threads.reason: This is one bargain with Warwick: metal from the Dwarven mine and the lyre, in exchange for the mithril shirt on loan against the plate armor. The mine is sealed by a cave-in and nothing has been delivered yet.

new_threads.name: Protection from the dragon's poison
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi sought anti-poison remedies because they are hunting the dragon (beat_38). Neither Ingrid nor Vivian can supply them, so the need is still open.

new_threads.name: Vivian's message to Grimny
new_threads.reason: Dunk delivered Vivian's letter and scent to Grimny's ghost, who then ascended (beat_81), so nothing about the errand is still owed.

new_threads.name: The dead dwarf's ring
new_threads.reason: Dunk wears a magical, uninscribed ring that let him see Grimny's ghost. Whether it is cursed, and what else it does, is unknown.

new_threads.name: Who killed Grimny
new_threads.reason: Grimny believes his brother Bral killed him in the cave-in. That question, and the fate of the other dwarves, stands apart from the treasure hunt.
